summary: E2E testing of 4 HR features (Round 2): (1) Dashboard HR alert 'hr_auto_today'; (2) Temporary geo-exemption with from/to dates and state badge; (3) Correspondence reply drawer (send / send+close); (4) Employee device card + change-request without device_id. Backend verified via /app/memory/patches/test_round2.sh — all endpoints return expected shapes/messages (upcoming/active states, 400 for invalid dates, 403 for employee setting exemption, hr_auto_today alert with items[] + route, warnings_only filter, correspondence reply flow, device change-request + approve + first-check-in registration). Frontend verified via Playwright: (admin) /hr-locations المستثنون tab shows geo-exempt-from/to/search, picking EMP-100 with future dates creates geo-exempt-row with period '2026-10-04 → 2026-10-05' and state 'قادم'; geo-unexempt-{id} removes it. Dashboard: شؤون الموظفين tab → dash-alert-hr_auto_today card with count=6, toggle expands list showing employee names + kind, dash-alert-hr_auto_today-route navigates to /hr-attendance?tab=details&warnings=1 with att-det-warnings_only button prefixed '✓'. (admin) /hr-correspondence: kpi-employee → corr-row-{id} → corr-detail with corr-reply-input + corr-reply-send fires alert and shows corr-reply-0 with reply text; corr-reply-send-close fires confirm+alert and closes drawer reply input. (EMP-100) /hr-my-profile: hr-me-device shows DEV-UI, hr-me-device-request-btn opens prompt → alert → hr-me-device-pending appears and button hidden. All cleanup performed (device reset, record deleted, device requests/notifications/correspondence/geo_exempt cleared).

issues: Carry-over from previous iterations: non-blocking React 'Unexpected text node' warning; non-blocking Firebase 'default app does not exist' server log in preview env.

critical_code_review_comments: DashAlerts: when card is expandable (has items), the whole header toggles expand instead of navigating. The dedicated dash-alert-{key}-route button inside the expanded list is the only navigation path — intentional but less discoverable than tapping the header. Consider also allowing a chevron/CTA on collapsed state.
seed_data_creation: Created & cleaned up: 1 temp exemption for EMP-100 (via UI, then removed), 1 attendance record today for EMP-100 (DEV-UI), 1 hr_device_request, 1 hr_correspondence TEST_UI_REPLY. All removed via API + Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct testid for exemption employee picker is `geo-exempt-pick-{id}` (not `geo-exempt-opt-`). Dashboard alert navigation uses dedicated `dash-alert-hr_auto_today-route` button (toggle only expands). Dialogs: use page.on('dialog') to accept window.alert/confirm/prompt. Login flow: fill two inputs then click text 'تسجيل الدخول'. To test as EMP-100 after admin, clear localStorage/sessionStorage then re-login.
rca of the issue: N/A — all features behaved as specified.
